passages.note: Enrolled bill text amending IC 16-34-2-1; prints the operative exceptions but not the voter list.
Senate roll call 58 on concurrence; Holdman is listed among the Yea votes.
Bill tracking/digest page; names the author and sponsors but not Holdman, and is a paraphrase summary rather than his own act or words.

rows.reasoning: Holdman voted Yea on SB 1(ss) (2022 First Special Session), a single-subject abortion bill whose amended IC 16-34-2-1 makes abortion a criminal act except for a serious health risk to the pregnant woman or to save her life, a lethal fetal anomaly before 20 weeks, or when 'the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest.' This matches the rung banning abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life, and excludes the rungs that keep abortion legal through a trimester or ban it with no exceptions.
